section.services.title: Services

section.sites.title: Sites
section.sites.hint: The sites Crisol serves: park and link folders, secure them with HTTPS, open them in the browser.
section.versions.title: Versions

section.logs.title: Logs
section.logs.hint: Follow the log of each service as it is written.
section.doctor.title: Doctor
section.doctor.hint: What Crisol finds wrong in this machine, with the fix for what it can fix.
section.credentials.title: Credentials
section.credentials.hint: The generated passwords of the databases, ready to copy, and a way to reset them.
section.setup.title: Setup
section.setup.hint: First-run setup of Windows, and removing Crisol from it.
section.settings.title: Settings
section.settings.hint: How Crisol behaves on this computer.
empty.title: Not here yet
empty.body: This section arrives in a later version of the app. The command line does all of it today.
services.none: The daemon reports no services yet.
services.no_daemon: There are no services to show while the daemon is not running. Press Start all to start it.
services.heading: Services in the daemon
service.web_stack: Web stack: starts with Start all
sites.heading: Sites
sites.parked_hint: Every folder inside a parked folder is a site. Unparking one stops serving them; your files stay where they are.
sites.none: There are no sites yet. Park a folder with your projects, or link one folder.
link.title: Link a folder as a site
link.name: Site name
link.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens. The folder keeps its place; Crisol only serves it under this name.
settings.terminal_hint: The terminal Crisol opens: with the PHP, Node and npm of Crisol first and the tools of other suites out of the way. The command crisol shell uses it too.
settings.terminal_none: No terminal was found on this computer.
banner.version: The daemon is of another version
banner.reload_error: The last web configuration was not applied
banner.blocked: Crisol is waiting to change the web stack
exit.title: The services keep running
exit.body: Quitting closes this window and the tray icon only. Your sites keep answering. To stop them as well, use Stop all and quit in the tray menu. This notice is shown once.
versions.none: The catalog offers nothing for this computer.
versions.done_used: {name} is now the version used everywhere
versions.warn_end_of_life: {name} no longer receives security fixes; use it only for an old project.
versions.warn_unverified: {name} was not verified by Crisol: it was installed with a hash you gave, not one from the catalog.
versions.missing_default: crisol.toml asks for {tool} {asked}, which is no longer installed; {version} is used instead. Pick one with “Use this one” so the commands stop warning about it.
logs.empty: The log is empty so far.
credentials.copy_failed: The clipboard did not accept the text. Select it and copy it by hand.
credentials.reset_reminder: Update the .env of every project that uses it: use “Copy all as .env” and paste the new lines.
credentials.reset_warning: A new password replaces the current one and every project that uses it must be updated. The data is kept.
credentials.reset_needs_daemon: Resetting a password goes through the Crisol daemon, which is not running. Use Start all first.
credentials.reset_stop_first: {name} reads its password only when it starts. Stop it, reset the password, then start it again.
credentials.reset_start_first: The password of {name} is changed by asking the running server. Start it first.
credentials.reset_busy: {name} is starting or stopping. Try again in a moment.
webview2.title: Crisol needs WebView2
webview2.body: Crisol draws its window with Microsoft Edge WebView2, which is not installed on this computer. Install the Evergreen runtime from https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/ and open Crisol again.
doctor.act.system_install: Install the helper (asks for administrator permission)
doctor.trust_already: Windows already trusts this CA; nothing will be asked.
doctor.trust_check: Windows will ask you to confirm. Check that the thumbprint (SHA-1) it shows is {sha1}
doctor.done.trust_added: Windows trusts the local CA now. A browser that was open may need a restart.
doctor.done.trust_already: Windows already trusts it; nothing was changed.
doctor.done.trust_declined: Windows was told no; nothing was changed.
doctor.done.untrust_declined: Windows was told no; nothing was changed.
doctor.done.untrust_none: No older Crisol CA is trusted; nothing was changed.
doctor.done.autostart_off: Crisol will not start when you sign in.
doctor.done.autostart_was_off: Crisol did not start when you signed in.
doctor.done.path_added: Crisol is now first in your user PATH. Open a new terminal to use it.
doctor.done.path_already: Crisol is already in your user PATH.
doctor.done.system_declined: The permission was refused; nothing was changed.
banner.setup: Crisol is not fully set up
banner.setup_text: A few things in Windows are left to do so that the commands and the https sites work.
setup.loading: Looking at what is set up…
setup.todo_hint: Each switch asks about something that changes more than your own files. Windows asks again before it trusts the certificate and before the administrator prompt.
setup.complete: Crisol is set up: there is nothing left to do.
setup.blocked: Crisol cannot be set up yet
setup.result_failed: Something failed; solve what is said and set up again, it only does what is left
step.helper: The administrator helper and the DNS rule
step.autostart: Start Crisol when you sign in
step.clean: What Crisol keeps in its folder
uninstall.heading: Uninstall Crisol
uninstall.hint: Takes Crisol out of Windows: the sign-in entry, the PATH, the certificates it made, the helper and its files. Your databases, settings and projects stay unless you choose otherwise.
uninstall.purge: Also delete my data, my settings and the Crisol folder
uninstall.purge_hint: Off by default: your databases, their passwords, your settings and your projects stay where they are.
uninstall.will: Crisol will undo, in this order
uninstall.nothing: Nothing of Crisol is left to undo in Windows.
uninstall.purge_deletes: Everything in {home} is deleted and cannot be recovered:
uninstall.projects: What is in its www folder, projects included
uninstall.foreign: These are not Crisol's, so the folder is not deleted
uninstall.backups: I have a backup of my projects and the databases I need
uninstall.result_left: Some of it is still in place; solve what is said and uninstall again to finish
uninstall.closing: This window closes in a few seconds so that Crisol's own files can be deleted.
